search.snippet: Bronze platebody (t) is a part of bronze trimmed armour and a reward from easy Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal Bronze platebody. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.
search.title: Bronze platebody (t) - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: It has no Defence requirement to equip and provides greater protection than a bronze chainbody. Like all platebodies, however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's Ranged and Magic stats. Players with level 18 Smithing can make one by using 5 bronze bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 62.5 experience.
search.title: Bronze platebody - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: The bronze platebody (t) is an item that can be obtained as a reward from an easy clue scroll, which is dropped by almost all monsters. A bronze platebody (t) has identical stat bonuses to a normal bronze platebody.

search.snippet: Poison ivy seeds are dropped by many monsters. They can also be stolen from master farmers or obtained from seed packs. Harvesting poison ivy berries from the patch near the Ardougne Monastery is a task in the hard Ardougne Diary.
search.title: Poison ivy seed - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: Poison ivy seed is a members-only item with a 4-hour buy limit of 200 and a high alchemy value of 99 coins. Over the last 30 days the price of Poison ivy seed has fallen 11.1%, ranging from 9 to 45 gp.

search.snippet: Poison Ivy bushes can be planted in a bush patch at level 70 Farming to yield poison ivy berries, which are used in Herblore to make weapon poison (++) or as protection payment for calquat trees (x8).
search.title: Poison Ivy bush - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: Poison ivy seeds are seeds that can be grown with level 70 Farming. They are planted in bush patches. These grow in two hours and forty minutes, yielding 674 experience from checking the health, and 45 experience per berry picked.
